scope: Current-host complete merge correctness selection, excluding the representative benchmark and foreign-target execution. This is not every nightly/release/live-service selection in the repository. Retain local platform-policy and packaging/release correctness checks.
conditional_acceptance: Full 1298-input session-equivalence oracle for session/provider changes; apply other affected area contracts as required. Count conditional preparation/execution inside its measured affected-edit scenario.
time_boundary: Start before candidate preparation and end after all assertions, child cleanup, evidence reconciliation and final result. Include rebuilds, required independent clean builds, installed artifact preparation, fixture setup, invalidation and restoring the ordinary development context. Initial dependency/toolchain bootstrap is separate and reported, never relabel a required per-run clean build as bootstrap.
